_instructions: Extract ALL available data from the event website. Use null for fields not found. Follow enum values exactly. All timestamps must be ISO 8601 format.

event.title: Full official event title
event.description: Complete event description (HTML or plain text, preserve formatting)
event.location: Human-readable location string (e.g. 'San Francisco, CA, USA')
event.virtual_platform: Platform name if virtual/hybrid (e.g. Zoom, Hopin)
event.target_audience: Who is this event for (e.g. 'Software engineers, DevOps professionals')

urls.source_url: URL of the page being extracted from
urls.event_image_url: URL of the main event banner/hero image
urls.agenda_url: URL of the dedicated agenda/schedule page if separate

tiers._note: Extract all visible pricing tiers/ticket types
tiers.name: Tier name (e.g. Early Bird, General Admission, VIP)

venue.name: Venue name (e.g. Moscone Center)
venue.venue_type: convention-center | hotel | university | office | online | other

speakers._note: Extract ALL speakers/presenters/panelists found. Include keynote speakers, session speakers, panelists, and workshop leaders.
speakers.name: Full name (required)
speakers.title: Job title (e.g. Senior Software Engineer)

agenda._note: Extract ALL sessions, talks, workshops, panels, breaks, and networking events. Each session is one item.
agenda.title: Session title (required)
agenda.agenda_type: keynote | talk | workshop | panel | networking | break | registration | lunch | other
agenda.location: Room or stage name within the venue

daily_schedule._note: High-level day-by-day schedule for multi-day events

tags: Tag names describing the event topics (e.g. 'AI', 'Cloud', 'DevOps', 'React', 'Security')

series._note: If this event is part of a recurring series (e.g. KubeCon, re:Invent)
series.name: Series name
